# Lead the Campus

Help students connect, navigate campus life, and build community at your university.

## What Is the BDStudents Ambassador Program?

BDStudents is building a global platform to connect Bangladeshi students across universities worldwide. Our goal is to cover every institution where Bangladeshi students are enrolled—so students can easily find community, trusted guidance, and opportunities wherever they study.

We are recruiting Campus Ambassadors from every university in the world, starting with institutions where Bangladeshi students are currently studying. Ambassadors act as connectors, not competitors—working alongside existing student organizations rather than replacing them.

Through BDStudents, ambassadors:

* Identify and confirm the presence of Bangladeshi students at your university
* Keep campus information accurate and up-to-date on BDStudents

...

## Ambassador Requirements

The BDStudents Ambassador Program is for students who are motivated, reliable, and committed to supporting their campus community.

To become a BDStudents Ambassador, you must:

* Be a Bangladeshi student currently enrolled at any university, college, or higher education institution
* Students from any country and any academic level (undergraduate, masters, PhD) are welcome

* On-campus and virtual events
* Campus tours

PROGRAMME UPDATE

Updated - December 2026
After much consideration, we have made the difficult decision to bring this iteration of the Video Games Ambassadors programme to an end. The current market conditions make it unsustainable for us to continue VGA in its existing form. However, we continue to believe strongly in the value and importance of connecting the games industry with schools, to inspire the next generation, open young people’s eyes to the varied career paths within games, and support diversity and inclusion within the sector.
We have built tremendous value in the idea of an ambassadors programme. Even though we cannot continue right now, we are not abandoning that vision. When market conditions improve, we will review the situation with the goal of developing proposals for a future ambassadors initiative, one that draws upon all we have learned and the strong foundation of VGA remains in place.
While this version of the VGA programme will end, there are still plenty of ways to get involved with Ukie, Digital Schoolhouse and other initiatives. These include but are not limited to, mentoring a team at the Ukie Student Game Jam, and or joining the Into Games Volunteer network.

Criado: Quinta, 15 de Outubro de 2026, 15h06 | Publicado: Quinta, 15 de Outubro de 2026, 15h06 | Última atualização em Quinta, 15 de Outubro de 2026, 15h19 | Acessos: 111
O Instituto Federal de Brasília (IFB), por meio da Diretoria de Comunicação Social (Dicom), publica a retificação do cronograma e o resultado final do Edital nº 1/2026 , referente à seleção de equipes de Embaixadores Estudantis para ações de divulgação institucional e do Processo Seletivo 2027/1.
A retificação altera duas datas do edital: a publicação do resultado final — inicialmente prevista para 9 de outubro — passou para 15 de outubro de 2026 ; e a formação on-line das equipes — antes programada para 12 a 16 de outubro — será realizada de 26 a 30 de outubro de 2026 .
As demais datas permanecem inalteradas. As ações de divulgação nos territórios estão previstas para ocorrer de 19 de outubro a 11 de dezembro de 2026 , com entrega da prestação de contas até 14 de dezembro de 2026.
Resultado final
Ao todo, quatro equipes foram aprovadas , representando os campi Brasília, Planaltina, Riacho Fundo e São Sebastião. A iniciativa busca aproximar o IFB das comunidades, ampliar o acesso às informações sobre os cursos gratuitos oferecidos pela instituição e incentivar o protagonismo estudantil.

El pasado viernes 23 de enero tuve el placer de recibir en la Delegación de la Unión Europea en México a los 31 Jóvenes Embajadoras y Embajadores por el Clima, para presentar los resultados de la segunda edición de la Red de Jóvenes Embajadores por el Clima UE-México. Este grupo de jóvenes, seleccionados por su capacidad de emprender acciones climáticas y que destacan por sus dotes de liderazgo, forman una red para fomentar las acciones individuales o colectivas en la protección del medio ambiente. Esa experiencia nos dejó una base sólida y la convicción de que este programa tiene un largo recorrido, debido al dinamismo de los jóvenes mexicanos, demostrando que es posible acelerar la acción

# MEXC Foundation and TRIV Launch F.I.R.E Scholarship to Empower Indonesia’s Next Generation of Blockchain Innovators

[MEXC Blog](https://blog.mexc.com/author/shaunt/) November 12, 2025 2 Mins Read [Press Release](https://blog.mexc.com/press-release/)

**November 12, 2025** – [MEXC Foundation](https://www.mexc.fm/foundation) , in partnership with Indonesia’s leading cryptocurrency exchange TRIV, today announced the launch of the F.I.R.E Scholarship Program (Future Innovators in Rising Economy), designed to cultivate Indonesia’s next wave of blockchain and Web3 leaders through education, mentorship, and real-world industry exposure.

The scholarship addresses a critical gap in Indonesia’s rapidly evolving digital economy: connecting academic excellence with practical blockchain expertise. Up to 20 students from six partner universities will receive full one-semester tuition support, access to the F.I.R.E Mentorship Lab featuring industry experts, and opportunities to serve as Student Ambassadors within global Web3 networks.

Applications open today through November 30, with recipients announced December 11. The program specifically targets students in technology, digital economy, and related fields at Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS), Universitas Surabaya (UBAYA), Universitas Ciputra (UC), Bina Nusantara University (BINUS), Universitas Indonesia (UI), and Universitas Multimedia Nusantara (UMN).

News Event

UIN Raden Fatah Palembang Advances Green Campus Commitment Through GCC 2026

01 Oct 2026 • UI GreenMetric
UIN Raden Fatah Palembang Advances Green Campus Commitment Through GCC 2026
PALEMBANG, INDONESIA, 1 Oct 2026 – Universitas Islam Negeri (UIN) Raden Fatah Palembang is strengthening its commitment to sustainable campus development through the Green Campus Competition (GCC) 2026 . The university held a socialisation session on 1 October 2026 at the Auditorium on the fourth floor of its Administrative Centre Building at the Jakabaring Campus, bringing together representatives from faculties and university work units.
The session introduced the competition’s eight assessment criteria and outlined how each faculty and work unit can incorporate sustainability into its programmes and daily operations. The initiative aims to build a shared understanding of green campus practices and encourage stronger environmental responsibility across the university community.
The eight GCC 2026 criteria cover environmental management, energy efficiency, water conservation, waste management, green infrastructure, education and research, sustainability governance, and green innovation and campaigns. Together, these areas provide a framework for the university to assess existing practices, identify areas for improvement, and develop more coordinated sustainability initiatives.

Help students connect, navigate campus life, and build community at your university.

## What Is the BDStudents Ambassador Program?

BDStudents is building a global platform to connect Bangladeshi students across universities worldwide. Our goal is to cover every institution where Bangladeshi students are enrolled—so students can easily find community, trusted guidance, and opportunities wherever they study.

We are recruiting Campus Ambassadors from every university in the world, starting with institutions where Bangladeshi students are currently studying. Ambassadors act as connectors, not competitors—working alongside existing student organizations rather than replacing them.

## Student Ambassador Programs: A Complete Guide

### What Is a Student Ambassador Program

A student ambassador program is a structured, ongoing partnership between a brand or institution and a group of students who represent it on campus and across social media. Unlike a one-off influencer collaboration, an ambassador program builds a longer-term relationship, giving the brand a consistent, trusted presence within a student community over time.

Ambassador programs are used by both consumer brands looking to reach Gen Z audiences and by universities and colleges looking to support their own admissions and campus life marketing through genuine student voices.

KU-SDG Ambassador Program

The KU-SDG Ambassador Program is a co-curricular program to teach students about innovation, entrepreneurship and leadership with a focus on sustainability through a series of workshops. The program also helps to build upon the university’s membership into the UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network and introduce the UN-SDGs to students; equipping them with the knowledge to contribute towards giving back to the community.
After an introductory session in Fall and Spring, workshops are organized every few weeks that address one of the categories outlined and presents a scenario on issues pertinent to the problems addressed. Each one relates to the SDGs of the session and provides a task for participants to research, evaluate, and monitor the development and progress of the SDGs in the UAE and from a global perspective wherever is appropriate, as well as to innovate, be an entrepreneur, and lead a community project, where possible.

The College of Health Science (CoHS) at Abu Dhabi University is launching the “Health and Wellness Ambassador Program”, targeting CoHS students and graduates.
